title: SAIF-VERSE Update v1.0.4 — Real Device Analytics & Automated Sync
changelog:
🌸 What's New in v1.0.4:
• Fixed native UsageAnalytics bridge for 100% genuine device data
• Removed simulated data fallback: only displays real installed apps & unlocks
• Automated daily community broadcast (manual share button removed)
• Offline queueing: usage data safely auto-pushes when internet reconnects
• Native Usage Access permission prompt & deep-link into Android settings
